summary: E2E frontend testing of Orcamentos (Quotes) module on CRM tenant. Login OK, Orcamentos sidebar item OK, all 4 tabs render with correct data-testids, Service+Freight CRUD OK, default 'Padrao Comercial' template auto-seeded (1 template visible), 23 placeholder chips OK, new client inline creation OK, default template auto-pre-selected in QuoteEditor. CRITICAL ISSUE FOUND: nested ModalShell components (parent QuoteEditor + child catalog picker) both use the same z-index (z-50). The parent fixed-overlay div intercepts pointer events on pick-service-{id} / pick-freight-{id} buttons inside the nested modal. Playwright timed out (30s) clicking the buttons; visually the modal renders correctly. Real users may experience the same blocking depending on browser stacking — confirmed via Playwright that the parent overlay captures the click. As a result, the editable-unit-price test, freight catalog pick, save-quote, preview, and print steps could not be exercised through the catalog flow.

ui_bugs.issue: Nested modals share z-50. Inner catalog picker (pickService/pickFreight) is rendered INSIDE the parent ModalShell's content; the parent overlay div (`fixed inset-0 bg-black/50 z-50`) intercepts pointer events on `[data-testid^=pick-service-]` and `[data-testid^=pick-freight-]` buttons. Playwright reports: '<div ... intercepts pointer events>' at OrcamentosPage.js line 780. Fix: render nested ModalShell at higher z (e.g., z-[60]) or via createPortal with explicit stacking.

rca of the issue: RCA: Component `ModalShell` in /app/frontend/src/pages/CRM/OrcamentosPage.js (line ~779) uses `fixed inset-0 bg-black/50 z-50` for ALL instances. When a nested modal is rendered as a child of another ModalShell (via QuoteEditor's `{pickService && <ModalShell ...>}` at line 712), the inner overlay shares z-50 with the outer; even though it appears later in the DOM, Playwright (and likely some browsers) compute the OUTER overlay div as still receiving pointer events at that location. Reproduction: open Orcamentos → Novo Orcamento → click 'pick-service-btn' → try clicking any [data-testid^=pick-service-] item. Mitigation: pass an explicit higher z-index to nested instances, e.g., `<ModalShell ... zIndex='z-[60]'>`, or always render ModalShell via createPortal(document.body) with incrementing stacking context.
